title: Web administration panel (port 8080) binds to all network interfaces including public IPv6 addresses, making internal…
description: The web administration panel on port 8080 binds to all network interfaces, including public IPv6 addresses. This configuration exposes internal API endpoints to the wide area network (WAN) without firewall protection, increasing the risk of unauthorized access. This vulnerability is related to CVE-2026-50224 and has a critical severity rating with a CVSS 4.0 score of 10.0.
